g.text: natural runoff, ITAG plants and river
Oberems–Turtmann, since 1925 · 772 m · split not documented
natural runoff, ITAG plants and river
Oberems–Turtmann, since 1925 · 772 m · split not documented
• Natural runoff from BAFU MQN (modelled mean flows, recent reference period); glaciers were larger c. 1950, so absolute volumes are indicative.
• Gallery intake: monthly mean flow at Vissoie capped at 7 m³/s gives ≈ 126 hm³/yr; daily peaks would add spill. Gallery enlarged to 12 m³/s in 1954/55 (R01 p3).
• No residual-flow rules before 1958: water not taken by the gallery stays in the river. The Turtmänna split between ITAG plants and river is not documented.
• Concessions: Navisence Vissoie–Chippis to AIAG for 99 years (1905); upper Navisence to SIS (1908); Gougra waters granted 1943 (R04 p77).
Edge width ∝ annual volume; values in hm³/yr (million m³). Plant volumes are the same water used in series. Reference IDs [R##] are listed in EVIDENCE.md.
